title: Kestral Royale - Battle other players across 28 million different star systems!
author: Dangerous-Eye-215
selftext:
My game is nearing completion! Fight to survive. Conquer to expand. Build an empire that lasts.

I've been developing Kestral Royale, a space-based Battle Royale and persistent empire-building hybrid where your progression doesn't end when the match does.

Battle across millions of visually unique star systems, earning collectible cards, population, and resources to grow your own permanent empire.

Outside of Battle Royale matches, there's an entire galaxy to explore, conquer, and compete in:  
  
Empire Building: Construct Tier 1–3 fleets, grow your population, and expand your territory by conquering additional star systems.  
  
Ranked PvP: Challenge other commanders in 1v1 arena battles and climb the leaderboards.  
  
Exploration: Launch expeditions into distant star systems to discover and recover valuable resources.  
  
Coalitions: Form alliances, work toward shared seasonal objectives, and unlock exclusive rewards.  
  
Live Chat: Connect with other commanders through world and coalition chat.  
  
Card Collecting: Expand your collection through gameplay.  
  
System Customization: Discover, bookmark, and relocate to your favorite star systems among millions of visually distinct environments.

**Monetization**

There are NO FORCED ADS. Rewarded ads are entirely optional and offer opportunities to accelerate progression.

An optional Visual Pass+ subscription unlocks a significantly larger selection of star system customization options, environments, and additional models.

Every player receives a free 24-hour Visual Pass+ each week, with opportunities to earn additional free days through coalition rewards. I wanted even free-to-play players to have opportunities to experience premium visual content without spending money.

\-----

**How I Developed the Game**

This has been a project built in Unity over the last 6+ months with the help of several generative AI tools.

I initially started development with ChatGPT, eventually moving to Astra on the $100/month plan. Over the last month, I switched to Claude Fable 5.2 on the $200/month plan to help bring the game across the finish line.

Here's a breakdown of the tools I've used throughout development:  
  
Unity: Game engine.

ChatGPT and Claude: Programming, gameplay systems, multiplayer infrastructure, debugging, and overall development.

ChatGPT and Gemini: Concept art, visual assets, ship designs, and derelict alien structures.

Meshy: Converting AI-generated concept images into usable 3D models.

ElevenLabs: UI sound effects and immersive radio transmissions.

Suno: Original in-game soundtrack.

It's been amazing to see what an individual developer can accomplish with the AI tools available today. What started as an idea has grown into a multiplayer game with persistent progression, competitive gameplay, procedurally generated environments, and social systems.

**Platforms and Playtesting**

Kestral Royale will be playable on Android through the Google Play Store and directly through web browsers on desktop and mobile devices. I'm still deciding whether to pursue a native iOS release or allow Apple users to just play through their browsers.

I'm currently waiting for my website and H5 ads to pass Google's review process. I'm also planning to submit the Android build for playtesting within the next day or two.

I'll need testers!

If you're interested in becoming an early Android playtester, leave a comment or send me a message, and I'll provide a Google Play link as soon as it's available.

If you're an iPhone user or would prefer to play on desktop, I can provide access to the browser version once the Google AdSense/H5 reviews are complete.

comments.body: This actually looks really interesting! I like the idea of combining a battle royale with building a permanent empire instead of starting over after every match. The exploration and alliance features sound pretty cool too. I'd definitely be interested in being an early tester! How close are you to getting the game ready for people to try? 😊

replies.author: Dangerous-Eye-215
replies.body: Very close, I'll comment here once it's ready. Thanks!

comments.author: Dasshteek
comments.body: This is a great concept. Well done OP

replies.author: Dangerous-Eye-215
replies.body:
Hey thanks, I appreciate that 👍

What's funny is I was working on these as seperate games, one an empire builder and the other a battle royale. I thought to myself, there's not enough battling in the empire builder, and there's not enough to do in the Royale game, solved 2 problems at once by combining the two together

comments.author: roodammy44
comments.body: Did you also play Planeterion when you were younger? I used to love that game, but it's most fun when you have a group of friends.

replies.author: Dangerous-Eye-215
replies.body:
I can't say I've ever played that one, though I've just looked it up it and it looks pretty good, and it must be if it's still operational after more than 20 years. I'll need to check it out. There are a few loose gameplay similarities to what I've made here!

My main inspiration for this was actually No Man's sky. I had a good time going from star system to star system, and exploratory space games are my favorite. I couldn't find a game on mobile like that with the same visual intensity so I figured I'd try my hand at it while throwing in some combat with the exploration aspect. I've added coalition/alliances as well so that players can make friends, and there's even a duos mode so they can play together on a team!
